_comment: iteration-9 pilot: harness validation, not a verdict.
Full plan is 96 reports (13 synthetic x 2 versions x 3 runs = 78, plus
3 real files x 2 versions x 3 runs = 18) against the shared iteration-8
baseline. This pilot ran 3 real files x 2 versions x 1 run = 6 cells.
n=3 pairs makes the pre-registered bar arithmetically unreachable: the best
possible outcome is 3 wins / 0 losses, which is p = 0.25, above 0.05.
So the sign-test result below is not evidence either way. What the pilot
establishes is that the generation -> gate -> pair -> test chain runs, and
that the attempt log below is a real hazard.
n_attempts is recorded per the plan's rule that only completed reports must
never be reported: a completion rate that rose while quality fell would be

scope.baseline: not re-run; iteration-8's 26 baseline reports are version-independent
scope.prompt: identical across versions; version is selected only by the skill load path

preflight: all 3 clean: valid UTF-8, no BOM, no U+FFFD, no NUL, ABAP keywords present

attempts.note: attempts 1 and 2 produced zero output with the standard prompt. attempt 3 succeeded but with an added line telling the agent to limit scope to 8-12 methods. That report is therefore not comparable to the other five and must be read as unmeasured for the primary endpoint.
attempt 1 produced zero output; attempt 2 used the standard prompt plus a reminder to actually write the file.

attempt_totals.note: both arms hit zero-output failures; the split is 1 vs 2 across 3 cells each, which is not informative. The failure mode is silence, not a partial file, so it is not a truncation problem.

primary_endpoint.pre_registered_criterion: NOT MET (p = 0.5 >= 0.05); fewer defects overall but not on enough pairs
primary_endpoint.base_rate_note: on this real corpus the arm_a gate failure rate is 2 of 3 reports (67%) carrying a defect, against 23% on the synthetic set of iteration-8. The real corpus is a harder gate, which is the opposite of the assumption the pre-registered ceiling was built on.

secondary_endpoints.truncation: 0 of 6 truncated. All six have 6/6 sections. The coverage signal cannot fire here: its threshold is sources above 2000 lines and the largest source in this pilot is 1598, so only the section signal was active.
secondary_endpoints.citation_fidelity: not measured by the harness in this pilot. Three of the six agents reported running --fidelity-only to PASS themselves; that is self-report and is not a harness measurement.
